subject.title: Feature Request: Dashboard Session Routing for User Notifications

question: Should external notifications be a transient broadcast to connected Control UI clients, durable messages directed to an explicitly chosen session, or a separately configured notification destination?
rationale: The issue proposes several materially different product models, and source-level implementation cannot safely choose their multi-client routing, persistence, privacy, and offline-delivery semantics.

options.title: Connected-client notifications
options.body: Add a gateway event for authorized connected Control UI clients and render a toast or inbox item without silently writing into an agent transcript.

options.title: Explicit durable destination
options.body: Allow a configured or caller-supplied session target for durable chat entries, with no automatic inference from dashboard activity.

options.title: Active-session registry
options.body: Adopt a single active-session registry only after defining conflict resolution, expiry, authorization, and no-connected-client behavior.

recommendation.title: Connected-client notifications
recommendation.body: Add a gateway event for authorized connected Control UI clients and render a toast or inbox item without silently writing into an agent transcript.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Control UI activity semantics and the gateway session contract.
